definitions.gloss: opening a shop, establishing a store/branch
definitions.explanation: Opening a new retail location or branch of a business. Used in business contexts for chain expansion or new store openings.

definitions.gloss: setting up a stall, having a booth
definitions.explanation: Setting up a temporary stall or booth at a market, festival, or event.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as でみせ when used as a standalone noun meaning "branch store" or "stall" (the store itself, rather than the act of opening one). The reading {出店|しゅってん} emphasizes the action of opening/establishing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧{出店|しゅってん}: new store opening
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{出店|しゅってん}: opening stores overseas
- {出店|しゅってん}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: store opening plan
- ⟦フリーマーケット→フリーマーケット：09804_furiimaaketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出店|しゅってん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set up a stall at a flea market
